description: Put a list of ingredient lines to a different number of people. Pass 'factor', or else the pair 'from_servings' and 'to_servings'. Quantities are recomputed by this server and not by the site, and every line says under 'scaling' whether the arithmetic landed exactly, whether the figure was moved to stay usable in a kitchen, or whether the line carried nothing to multiply.

factor.description: What to multiply every quantity by. Pass this or the servings pair, never both.

from_servings.description: How many people the list feeds as written.

ingredients.description: The lines to scale, as a recipe writes them, such as '200g plain flour'.

to_servings.description: How many people it should feed.

name: scale_ingredients

factor.description: What every quantity was multiplied by.

amount_max.description: The upper bound when the line gives a range.

original.description: The line as it was given.

scaling.description: 'scaled': the arithmetic landed exactly. 'rounded': the figure moved to stay usable in a kitchen. 'unscaled': the line carried no quantity.

text.description: The line as it now reads.

unscaled_count.description: Lines that carried no quantity to multiply.

title: Scale a list of ingredients
